top_signals.title: UK investors face three-month wait to recoup money from property funds
top_signals.summary: FCA seeks to avoid repeat of fund suspensions during market turmoil by restricting immediate access to investments in illiquid assets

top_signals.title: Windshield Repair Group Belron Picks Banks for Europe IPO
top_signals.summary: Safelite and Autoglass owner Belron Group SCA has selected investment banks to lead a potential initial public offering that could be Europe’s largest in years, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: Hertz Lenders Team Up With Advisers as Possible Debt Fight Looms
top_signals.summary: Creditors to Hertz Global Holdings Inc. are organizing across at least two groups, bracing for potential negotiations with the car rental company over its billions of dollars of debt that comes due over the next few years, according to people familiar with the matter.
